about: The Preface of the Ascension of the Lord. It praises Christ, who after His Resurrection appeared to all His disciples and was raised up into heaven before their eyes, to make us partakers of His divinity. It is the proper Preface of the feast of the Ascension. From the Friday after the Ascension to the Friday before the Vigil of Pentecost it is said as the Preface of the season in every Mass that has no proper Preface.

s01.narrative: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

s02.translation: Truly it is right and just, fitting and leading to salvation, that we should give You thanks always and everywhere, O Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God, through Christ our Lord. He, after His Resurrection, appeared openly to all His disciples and, while they beheld Him, was raised up into heaven, that He might grant us a share in His divinity. And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominions, and with all the host of the heavenly army, we sing the hymn of Your glory, evermore saying:

alignments.gloss: always and everywhere give thanks to You
He might grant us a share in His divinity
